author: Inside Edition
description: Shivon Zilis, the mother of four of Elon Musk's children, said that the billionaire abruptly ended their relationship and called him "a tortured soul." Zilis, a tech executive from Canada, says she was blindsided by the breakup. In a statement on Musk's X social media platform, Zilis wrote in part, “It’s hard to go from in love to let go in a week with no warning, but that’s just how it is sometimes." Inside Edition reached out to Musk for comment on the breakup but did not hear back.
title: Elon Musk's Girlfriend And Baby Mama Says He Abruptly Ended Their Relationship

author: Inside Edition
description: There's a bitter war brewing between actress Halle Berry and the father of her 12-year-old son, Maceo. Berry's ex-husband, actor Olivier Martinez, has been granted a temporary restraining order against the Oscar winner, accusing her of having "abusive tendencies" and "violent mood swings." Berry's attorney tells Inside Edition that Martinez's claims are "entirely meritless and deliberately misleading."
title: Halle Berry's Ex Granted Temporary Restraining Order Against Her

author: Inside Edition
description: The frat house where a Cornell University student alleged she was drugged and raped by seven fraternity members in 2024 has been closed down. Now, we're getting a look inside the structure. In a major development, New York governor Kathy Hochul announced Friday that State Attorney General Letitia James has been appointed as special prosecutor to investigate the student's allegations. Inside Edition's Andrea Grimes reports.
title: A Look Inside The Cornell University Frat House At Center Of An Alleged Rape

author: Inside Edition
description: The investigation into the failed execution of convicted murderer Christa Pike continues. Two injections intended to kill Pike were administered to the death row inmate earlier this week, but they did not kill her. Pike was supposed to be the first woman executed in Tennessee in more than two centuries. In the wake of the failed execution, the mother of Colleen Slemmer, who Pike killed 31 years ago, is sending out a strongly worded message.
title: Mother Of Woman Christa Pike Killed Still Wants Pike Dead

author: Inside Edition
description: It has been 32 years since Denise Brown took the stand at the murder trial of O.J. Simpson, and testified about his history of beating her sister, Nicole Brown Simpson. Now, Denise tells ABC News' Diane Sawyer that the nation needs a fresh lesson in how domestic violence can escalate. Denise is urging victims of domestic abuse to heed the warning signs before it is too late. Denise is speaking out as she releases her new book, "For My Sister Nicole: Love Shouldn't Hurt."
title: Nicole Brown Simpson's Sister Hopes To Raise Awareness About Domestic Abuse

author: Inside Edition
description: Ben Coleman thought he hit the jackpot when he found a vintage video camera for $130 on eBay. But when the camera was delivered to him, Coleman discovered something priceless inside: precious home movies from a previous owner. The videos were recorded sometime between 1998 and 2006. Coleman went on a mission to find the family. Thanks to social media, it took just 24 hours to track them down.
title: Man Finds Family Whose Home Movies Were On His Vintage Video Camera

author: Inside Edition
description: The Manhattan District Attorney released video of Luigi Mangione's arrest, never before shown outside of court. Bodycam video shows his arrest at a McDonald's by police in Altoona, Pennsylvania. Days earlier on December 4th, 2024, the CEO of United Healthcare had been shot dead on a Manhattan street. The NYPD released a photo of the suspect that went national. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Newly Released Video Shows Luigi Mangione's 2024 Arrest In Pennsylvania

author: Inside Edition
description: Influencer and ALS advocate Brooke Eby has died. She was diagnosed at age 33, and dedicated her life to sharing her journey battling the illness. Brooke's incredible style of storytelling combined humor and wit to educate others about the everyday difficulties of living with the disease. Brooke founded ALStogether, an online community created to connect people living with ALS and their caregivers with others who truly understand their experiences. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: ALS Advocate Brooke Eby Has Died

author: Inside Edition
description: Honesty is always the best policy, but this man's reason for speeding wasn't enough to get him out of a ticket. The Manassas City Police in Virginia released bodycam of the conversation he had with the officer who pulled him over. The motorcyclist claimed he was trying to get to McDonald's before they stopped serving breakfast. The officer could see this incident as a clear non-emergency and issued a fine. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Motorcyclist Fined For Speeding To Get To McDonald's In Time For Breakfast

author: Inside Edition
description: As convicted murderer Christa Pike awaits her fate following her failed execution, her co-defendant remains behind bars indefinitely. Tadaryl Shipp is incarcerated at the Northwest Correctional Complex in Tiptonville, Tennessee. He was also convicted in the brutal death of 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer in 1995. Shipp was sentenced to life in prison; since he was 17 at the time of the killing, he was not eligible for the death penalty. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Where Is Christa Pike's Co-Defendant Tadaryl Shipp?
